'''2009 Coruscant Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 8 August 2009, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS17]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2009 Coruscant Regionals.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 8 August 2009
* '''Winner:''' —
